name: Mobula API
description: Onchain trading backend for trading apps, bots, and traders. Swap routing and execution across 90+ EVM chains and Solana (Uniswap v2/v3/v4, PancakeSwap, SushiSwap, Curve, Raydium, Jupiter) plus launchpad and bonding-curve coverage (PumpFun, Meteora, Raydium Launchlab, FourMeme). Cross-chain bridging through Mobula's own router. Real-time and historical market data: token prices, OHLCV candles, DEX trades, holder and trader analytics, wallet portfolios with PnL, DeFi position tracking, on-chain wallet labels, and token security audits. Live Pulse feed of new token launches and trending pairs. Official SDK: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mobula_labs/sdk | TypeScript types: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mobula_labs/types | Open-source trading terminal: https://mtt.gg (source: https://github.com/MobulaFi/MTT).
